# Third-party images CI pulls, mirrored to GHCR so CI does not depend on
# anonymous pull quota at public.ecr.aws or Docker Hub (both answer 429 to the
# shared GitHub-hosted runner IPs). Read by scripts/ci/base-images.sh.
#
# Columns: name, upstream (the default end users pull, exactly as written in
# apps/cloud/Dockerfile or packages/cli/src/local-stack.ts), then fallback
# sources for the same tag. The mirror is
# ghcr.io/<owner>/membral-mirror-<name>:<upstream tag>.
#
# binfmt and buildkit are the images docker/setup-qemu-action and
# docker/setup-buildx-action pull from Docker Hub.
#
# Tags are not digest-pinned (a follow-up): the weekly mirror run follows
# upstream tag moves.
#
# Changing an image: edit it here and at its upstream use in the same PR
# (`scripts/ci/base-images.sh check` fails CI when they drift).
node      public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node:20-bookworm-slim  docker.io/library/node:20-bookworm-slim
caddy     public.ecr.aws/docker/library/caddy:2-alpine         docker.io/library/caddy:2-alpine
postgres  public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.166          docker.io/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.166
gotrue    public.ecr.aws/supabase/gotrue:v2.196.0              docker.io/supabase/gotrue:v2.196.0
postgrest public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgrest:v14.5              docker.io/postgrest/postgrest:v14.5
binfmt    docker.io/tonistiigi/binfmt:latest
buildkit  docker.io/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1
